tools.name: save_resume
tools.description: Store the user's base resume, either as raw text or by reading a local file. Overwrites any previously stored resume. Provide exactly one of resume_text or resume_path.

resume_path.description: Absolute path to a .pdf, .txt, or .md resume file to read instead of passing raw text

tools.name: save_voice_profile
tools.description: Store a description of the user's writing voice/tone (e.g. tone attributes, phrases to avoid, sample posts). Used to keep generated cover letters and LinkedIn About sections sounding like the user, not generic AI copy.

voice_text.description: Description of tone, style, and things to avoid

tools.name: get_voice_profile
tools.description: Retrieve the stored voice profile, if one has been saved.

tools.name: save_jd
tools.description: Store a job description for a company/role and mark it as the active application. Creates a new application record. Provide exactly one of jd_text or jd_path.

jd_path.description: Absolute path to a .pdf, .txt, or .md job description file to read instead of passing raw text

tools.name: get_active_application
tools.description: Returns the stored resume, voice profile, and the active job description together, as context for match analysis or content generation. Use this to: (1) run match analysis — identify genuine overlaps and honest gaps between the resume and JD, not keyword stuffing; (2) draft a tailored resume by reordering/reframing existing resume content for relevance, never fabricating experience; (3) draft a cover letter; (4) draft a LinkedIn About section. Match the voice profile's tone if one is set. Save any generated output with save_output.

tools.name: list_applications
tools.description: List all stored applications (company, role, created date).

tools.name: save_output
tools.description: Persist generated content (match analysis, tailored resume, cover letter, or LinkedIn About draft) for an application. Defaults to the active application if application_slug is omitted.

application_slug.description: Optional — defaults to the active application

tools.name: save_story
tools.description: Save a career story directly (title, tags, content) without running the interview flow. Prefer start_story_interview for a guided capture.

tools.name: query_stories
tools.description: Retrieve saved career stories, optionally filtered by tag (e.g. leadership, conflict, failure-recovery, technical-deep-dive). Use to find a story relevant to a JD requirement, an interview-prep question, or a LinkedIn post idea.

tools.name: start_story_interview
tools.description: Begin a structured interview to capture one new career story. Returns the first question and a session_id. Keep calling answer_story_question with that session_id, relaying each returned question to the user verbatim, until status is 'complete' — the story is then auto-saved.

tools.name: answer_story_question
tools.description: Submit the user's answer to the current interview question and get the next one (or the completed, saved story).
